notes.title: Corrections in 1.1.3~1.1.7
notes.notes:
This is a summary of bug fixes from 1.1.3(11/19)~1.1.7(11/21).

Fixes in the main game
　Fixed that enemies appearing at the same time as the boss fight also escape.
　Fixed a bug that caused skill points to be overwritten
　Fixed a bug that skill points could be increased infinitely.
　Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze.
　Fixed a bug that caused the effect of Sakura Bamboo to become almost 4 times stronger.
　The time description has been changed so that it is always updated.
　Fixed a bug that caused the beginning of the first day to be at night.
　Fixed a bug that allowed the maximum level of mushrooms to be released more than once.

Fixed a bug in the UI.
　Fixed a bug that prevented players from turning slots using the keyboard on the title screen.
　Fixed a bug that prevented retiring during result or during result transition.
　Fixed a problem with the volume bar in the settings screen.
　Fixed so that the setting screen cannot be displayed even if the ESC key is pressed when the gear button cannot be pressed.
　
Added functions
　The “A,W,D” key on the keyboard can now be used to press the “Left,Center,Right” stop/spin button.

notes.notes:

notes.title: major update1.1.0
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience.
A major update of JACKPOISON has been implemented.

[The update includes]
Slots
Slot has been changed so that the reels can be stopped at any time by pressing the button at the bottom.
The color of the mushroom pattern has been changed, and it is now implemented as a role that can be formed if one of the mushrooms appears on the left reel.
The mushrooms are now represented as “Chance” or “Reach” depending on the type of mushrooms.
We are planning to add more chance and “riichi” patterns in the future.

About the overall game flow
When the start button is pressed, the stage selection screen is now displayed.
The game progresses according to the clock and date gauge.
When the clock hand reaches the rightmost point, the date gauge advances by one day, and the clock hand returns to the leftmost point.
As the date progresses, more powerful enemies appear.
A boss will appear on the morning of the fourth day.
If you can defeat the boss, the stage is cleared.
After clearing a stage, you can select the next stage on the stage selection screen.
When the game is cleared or the game is over, you will be returned to the title and your money, items, temporarily increased status, etc. will be reset.
When returning to the title, skill points can be earned based on the game's results.
These skill points can be used to upgrade the main character.

Combat
Combat has been changed to occur only at night.
Random battles will occur at night.
During the battle, the enemy and the protagonist take turns attacking each other on each spin.
HP gauges have been added to slimes and bosses.
In addition, the game has been changed so that players can purchase items when they win a battle.

About the purchase of items
Mushroom items have been modified to have permanent effects once acquired.
We intend to adjust, change, and add more mushroom skills in the future.
In addition, only one recovery potion and one skill point can be purchased at a time on this screen.

About Skills
As mentioned in the “How the Game Works,” skill points earned at the end of each stage can be used to upgrade skills.
Upgrades mainly consist of those related to enhancing the main character's status, mushrooms, and slots.

[About the future]
About the next update
In the last two weeks, we plan to update mainly with bug fixes and minor adjustments.
We will also update the reels to work properly even in low frame rate environments.

Subsequent updates
Depending on user feedback,
We will prioritize updating the game to make each stage different from the others.
We are thinking of adding mini-games that occur randomly as you progress through the stages.
We are also planning to update the game to support steam achievements as soon as possible.


[Conclusion.]
We apologize for delaying the update for two weeks.
I am very grateful to all those who have played JACKPOISON, given us words of support, and written serious reviews about the game.
I will continue to keep updating the game and I will keep you posted,
If you still support JACKPOISON, please continue to do so.

notes.title: apology
notes.notes:
Thank you for reading.

First of all, we would like to apologize.
　We have decided to postpone the update date until 11/15, as I was notified on the same day in X.
　Due to my negligence, I failed to inform you of this on [b]steam. [/b]
　This is completely due to my negligence. I am very sorry.
　
　The reason for the update postponement was the sale.
　I was wrong about this as well.
　I know some of you were very disappointed.
　I am very sorry.


What will happen with this update?
　It is very difficult to say,
　[b]We would like to update on 11/15 as we have announced. [/b]
　We have decided to postpone the update because we believe that we can make the game a little more interesting and satisfying.
We are currently in the process of reviewing and adjusting skills and game balance, so the update cannot be implemented immediately.


Why did you decide to postpone the update?
　I have been working on the update with the intention of doing the best I can to respond to the money we have received from current users.
　I have been working on the update to the best of my ability.
　I was more fixated than necessary on the point that “it is important to take action at the time of the sale.
　I also felt that if I had one more week, I could make it a little more interesting, or a little more satisfactory.
　We thought it would be more beneficial to postpone the update by one week.
　In fact, this was something that could have been adjusted after the update.

　Also, in working alone, I lost track of who was waiting for my update, and I failed to take into account the importance of this point, when in fact there were people who were expecting it.
　As for my failure to inform you on STEAM, it was also because I lacked the recognition that my postponement of the update was a disappointment to users' expectations.
　The very question and perception of “are there people waiting for the update?” was a big mistake and very, very rude. I am sorry for that.
　
Thank you for reading to the end.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Update Postponed
notes.notes:
As announced earlier on X (formerly Twitter), the update scheduled for 10/31 has been
We have decided to postpone the update scheduled for 10/31 until 11/08.

Reason
Due to certain circumstances, we thought that the date of 10/31 would reduce the opportunity for Steam users to play the game.
We have completed most of the updates as previously announced (except for the font change).
We will also use the time saved by the postponement to add a few more effects.

Changes from the previous update
The following is a list of additional changes to the previous update.
The changes have not yet been applied to the current version of the software.

　We have eliminated the “attack, damage taken, enemy appears” role.
　Enemies will now have a certain probability of appearing when a spin is made during non-combat.
　Attacks and damage taken will now alternate with each spin.
　Also, the enemy's attack will be a random attack of 1~3 hits.
　The main character will be able to attack any number of times out of 1~3 by charging coins to the attack gauge.

　Reach and chance eyes that have a certain probability of winning a bonus will be implemented.
　When a bonus is won by itself, a special direction will be executed with a certain probability.
　When a bonus is won, the lower left panel will announce that the bonus has been won.

　We have already announced that the font will be changed, but this is expected to be a time-consuming process,
　We will prioritize other updates in the 11/08 update,
　The font change will be made in the next update.
　If there are many requests for the font change to be prioritized here,
　If we receive enough requests for the font change to be prioritized, there is a possibility that the update date will be further postponed.


The above is in addition to the previously announced updates.
If you would like to see other updates in advance, please refer to the previous post.
If you would like to see other updates, please refer to our previous post, “[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3016690/view/6568028410379274575?snr=1_5_9_]Major Update Details Released in Advance[/url]”.

notes.title: Pre-release of major update details
notes.notes:
All currently scheduled updates will be made public.
Please note that these are currently planned and may change in the future.

Changes to the overall game
　Four stages will be changed so that players can select one of them at the title screen.
　The second and subsequent stages will be made playable by clearing the previous stage.

Changes related to combat
　When the game is over/the game is cleared, the player is returned to the title and the contents related to coins and mushrooms are reset.
　When the game is over/game is cleared, skill points will be awarded according to the results.
　Add HP to enemies.

About Boss Battles
　The special game system currently used for boss battles will be abolished.
　We are currently thinking of adopting the same format as normal battles, but this is still likely to be changed.

Changes related to skills
　We will move the skill button to the title screen and change it so that skills can no longer be opened in-game.
　The cost to purchase skills will be changed from coins to skill points.
　The content of skills will also be changed significantly in areas affected by this change.

Changes to the store
　The store button will be eliminated.
　Recovery will be available for purchase at the mushroom selection screen at the end of a battle.
　Other items that were previously available in the store will be removed.　
　
Changes to mushrooms
　Mushroom skills will be changed so that they do not decrease with the passage of turns, etc.
　We will make overall changes to the skills of mushrooms.
　(This change will make the player stronger the more mushrooms he eats.)
　Mushrooms will be made available for acquisition after the battle, with a choice of several mushrooms.
　Also, when acquiring mushrooms, players will pay coins according to the price of the mushrooms.
　Mushrooms will also be available outside of battle on rare occasions.
　Mushroom growth will occur each turn, and the number of mushrooms matched in a slot will be used to further advance the growth stage of the mushroom.

Slots
　The probability of winning a slot will be reduced and the payout will be increased.
　The obsolete skill button and store button will be replaced with a stop button, allowing the player to stop all three reels at any time.
　All action-related roles will be changed so that they depend on the result of eye-pushing.
　We are also planning to reflect the result of eye-pushers on the payout roles.

Other small changes
　The font of the dots is very difficult to see, so we plan to change the font for long sentences such as skill descriptions.
　We will add detailed descriptions such as when the probability changes depending on the climate and skills.

These are the currently planned updates.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Update Details and Next Update
notes.notes:
This time, we changed the mushrooms you get when you defeat an enemy.
This time, we changed the mushrooms you get when you defeat an enemy so that you can choose from three options.
In addition, in the recent update schedule, we had announced that we would change the probability and payout of slots, but we did not update these items this time.
We have concluded that this update will not be made without the scheduled updates, and that it may upset the balance of the game.

About the next update
We had planned to update the game little by little, but due to the nature of the game and the interaction of various elements, we have decided to update the game after all the planned changes have been implemented.
The next update is scheduled for October 31, but the schedule may change due to the long span of implementation work. Please understand.

We will provide all the details regarding the next update in a new post tomorrow.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Minimal functional additions, etc. / Next update
notes.notes:
Here are the contents of last night's (10/05) update.

Fixed a bug that prevented the spin button from being pressed under certain conditions.
Damage text is now more scattered.
(Fixed a situation where damage notations overlapped, making 1 x 3 damage look like 111 damage.)
Changed the long-press rotation to the initial implementation.
Added black borders to white text that was difficult to see due to color.
Added commas for every 1000 in numbers. (The font will be changed in the near future.)

Added functions
Changed so that the ESC key can be used to display the settings screen.
Added master volume to the settings screen.
Window/fullscreen can be changed in the settings window.


Next update
This time, we have fixed small issues first, considering that frequent updates will not be possible due to the major update work that is in progress.
In the next update, we plan to implement the following
　Reduce the overall winning rate of slots and increase the payout.
　Allow mushrooms to have 3 options to choose from after the battle is over.
The next update will be made on 10/09 at around 23:00.

notes.title: Future plans (positive ones)
notes.notes:
If you have purchased JACKPOISON or are at all interested, thank you for taking a look.

...Preface.
The fact that my current production of JACKPOISON is quite unpopular is apparent.
I have read the reviews on STEAM and the posts on social networking sites.
It is very informative.
I am very interested in your comments and opinions, and most of them are correct, but some of them are elementary points for marketing the game.

Specific improvements
Here are the most recent concrete plans.
First of all, we will improve critical bugs, such as the inability to turn slots.
Next,
Here are our immediate concrete plans.
The combat element took away too much of the thrill of the coins and the ups and downs of the game.
The slots have become too much of a controller to control the lead, instead of a combat element to the slots.
We would like to make significant improvements mainly in the position of the slots, such as the following.

About the future 
This is about the rough future of this game.
I will continue to work on this game at least until the end of October, even if the sales of this game do not increase, and I will try to improve what I can do with my time and ability.
I will also continue to touch more actual slots and improve my sensitivity.

Unfortunately, I do not have enough money at my disposal at the moment, and I am not a designer, so it will be difficult to implement new effects or new characters, depending on future sales.

However, I would like to improve the game balance, the clarity of the UI, the tempo of the game, and the addition of rudimentary functions as much as possible.
We will announce how we will make specific changes and where we will give priority to, as needed, in the form of “・Concrete Improvements” above.

・・Apologies
This game is not early access.
Despite the fact that the game is not an early access game, it is still immature and we can only see areas for improvement after receiving your feedback.
I am sure that many of you who purchased the game felt that it fell short of your expectations.
I apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
I apologize for that.
I also apologize for placing my apology at the bottom of the page, as I selfishly wanted to inform you of my policy first.

If anyone has any expectations for JACKPOISON in the future, I would appreciate your continued support.
